iteration_contract.non_overlapping_empty_resume: one complete Unicode scalar after previous match start
iteration_contract.overlapping_resume: one complete Unicode scalar after previous match start
iteration_contract.terminal_empty_match: yield once unless it begins exactly at the previous non-empty match end; that adjacent empty is discarded
iteration_contract.replacement_payload: whole-match spans with retained capture spans; template parsing and capture-reference expansion are deferred to R3.5
iteration_contract.trace_privacy: search offsets, spans, next offsets, resources, and fingerprints only; no matched text

limits.memory_formula: 1024 + max_iteration_trace_events * 80 + retained_matches * (128 + capture_slots * 32), combined with the current one-shot executor peak
limits.work_formula: one iteration unit per search attempt plus the sum of every one-shot search work count
